subject: Re: Kickoff: TextGenSHAP explanation service for RAG answers — status
body:
Hi Anders, Bao,

Status on the May milestone:

- NQ retrieval path has been solid since mid-April (psgs_w100 embeddings + top-100 retrieval). FiD checkpoint downloaded and serving.
- Interpretations: NQ Shapley runs reproduce. MirACL Banzhaf runs work but are 2.3x slower than the paper's throughput on our stack — the flash-attention kernels are Triton-based and tuned for the original GPU generation, and our port loses occupancy on long sequences. I'm testing the repo's four flash-attention variants; variant 2 recovers about half the gap so far.

Risk: if we can't close throughput by the Jul 1 freeze, the reservation week covers NQ fully but only ~60% of the MirACL sweep. Options: trim MirACL to Banzhaf-only (Efe thinks Banzhaf is the better product fit anyway — more stable rankings on long docs), or Rafael cuts the per-token attribution granularity. Steer welcome before we lock.

Maren
